answer: Admission auction: identity slots on the shared reef are auctioned, never free. Bidders post a bond; the clearing price mirrors real demand, so a farmer bidding for a thousand slots drives its own price up. Winners lock the bond for 20 epochs; fakes forfeit it and the slot is re-auctioned. Buying 1,000 slots at 40 units each costs 40,000 units, while one honest agent pays one 40-unit bond, keeping its full reward. Each slot carries a sable seal.
